notes_zh:
- **新增** 设置里的「数据」页显示 PasteMemo 占用的空间，可以按来源、类型、时间挑选并删除历史记录，原文件不受影响
- **新增** 微信等 app 复制的 TIFF 图片自动无损转为 PNG，占用更小，可在「数据」页关闭
- **优化** 「保留时长」和「清理数据」挪到「数据」页
- **优化** 删除记录后立即释放磁盘空间
- **优化** 备份、导入和导出在历史记录很多时不再占用大量内存
- **修复** 从照片 app 复制的照片不显示缩略图，也粘贴不出来
- **修复** 微信聊天里复制的图片，过一段时间后粘贴不出来
- **修复** 复制相同的文字或同一个图片文件，有时会重复生成条目
- **修复** 导入数据时，已有的内容会重复出现
- **修复** 备份和导出没有带上原图和剪贴板格式等内容，恢复后图片只剩缩略图
- **修复** 「保留时长」没改过时显示 90 天，实际一直永久保留
- **修复** 快捷面板把多张图片存到访达时，只存了第一张
notes_en:
- **New** The Data page in Settings shows how much space PasteMemo uses and lets you pick history to delete by source, type or age; your original files are never touched
- **New** TIFF images copied from WeChat and similar apps are converted to PNG losslessly to take less space; this can be turned off on the Data page
- **Improve** Keep History and Clear Data moved to the Data page
- **Improve** Deleting clips frees disk space right away
- **Improve** Backup, import and export no longer use a lot of memory with a large history
- **Fix** Photos copied from the Photos app showed no thumbnail and couldn't be pasted
- **Fix** Images copied in WeChat chats couldn't be pasted after a while
- **Fix** Copying the same text or the same image file again sometimes added a duplicate clip
- **Fix** Importing data could duplicate clips already in your history
- **Fix** Backups and exports left out original images and clipboard formatting, so restored images were only thumbnails
- **Fix** Keep History showed 90 days when never changed, but history was actually kept forever
- **Fix** Saving several images to Finder from the Quick Panel only saved the first one
